steps.description: I need to create a Python script that implements the described numerical experiment to test whether neural network generalization behavior probes solution space rigidity. The script will: (1) define abstract constraints (e.g., polynomial interpolation or functional equation constraints), (2) sweep over constraint count w, (3) for each w, find minimum hidden layer width N_c(w) that achieves zero violation on held-out constraints, (4) measure the trend of N_c(w) vs w. This is a pure ML/math experiment with no physical system mapping. I will write the script to run in the workspace directory and ensure it produces reproducible numerical results.
